title: Sleep a Night at Adventurous Places
subtitle: Get ready for the most epic sleepovers ever!
description: Imagine sleeping in the most amazing, crazy, and fantastic places on Earth. Which one would you choose?

fun_facts.text: The world's largest treehouse is over 10,000 square feet and has 80 rooms!
The longest recorded flight of a chicken is 13 seconds, but some chickens can sleep for up to 12 hours a day!
The world's largest ice cream sundae was over 5,000 gallons and had 2,000 pounds of toppings!
The largest dinosaur that ever existed is the Argentinosaurus, which could weigh over 100 tons and reach lengths of over 100 feet!
The first time machine was conceptually developed by H.G. Wells in his 1895 novel 'The Time Machine', and since then, time travel has become a staple of science fiction!
